overview.Module Title: Principles, Policies and Practices of Global Education

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The aims of this module are to: • Explore different approaches to educational planning and policy issues. • Consider the implications associated with designing and implementing educational reform, especially in a global context. • Consider the influence and impact of international, national and provincial agendas at the local level. • Analyze case studies and discuss issues related to language policies within global education institutions. • Evaluate the impact of English as a Medium of Instruction (EMI) on the internationalization of education.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Critically examine approaches to educational planning and policy issues B. Critically understand issues regarding language policies and Globalization C. Demonstrate a critical understanding of the importance of educational reforms D. Demonstrate the ability to critically engage with regional, national and international education policy documents
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components: lectures and tutorials/workshops. The mode of delivery can be online, offline, or blended learning. All delivery modes will be interactive, using a project-based approach where appropriate.
